items.text: Puka Nacua moved from GTD/optimism to officially ACTIVE for Week 7 vs Raiders despite calf issue; played and produced 8/68/1 + rushes.
items.why: ETR weekend summary listed GTD-opt; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed active pregame; McVay optimism on minor calf.
items.implication: WR1 lock with Adams out long-term; high target share expected ROS.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets lead with Adams IR; calf managed without limitation in game.

items.text: Breece Hall from GTD/pessimism to INACTIVE Week 7 (quad, 3rd straight miss); Allen filled in with 104 rush yards.
items.why: ETR listed GTD-pess; Rapoport sources said unlikely, no full practice; Schefter confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup elevated; Hall return timeline uncertain heading to Week 8.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share to Allen while Hall out.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then ACTIVE for MNF; post-game said hamstring came out great, back issue shouldn't keep him out.
items.why: ETR expected; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed active; self-report post-game positive on hamstring/back.
items.implication: RB1 volume secured short-term; monitor practice Week 8.
items.opportunity: Full role if healthy; Eagles depleted WRs boost checkdowns.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade first game back: led Broncos backfield snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Berry per-player: Coleman clear lead post-return usage vs committee.
items.opportunity: Snap/rush/route lead for Coleman; reverse prior beneficiaries.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide: almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if serious.
items.why: Levitan player-specific: purposeful/correct slide, low concern vs actual injury risk.
items.implication: No significant downgrade; RB1 usage intact Week 8.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT Week 7 (high ankle, 3rd straight miss); Huntley started in loss.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Rapoport noted close but missed, diagnosis high ankle.
items.implication: QB streamers/backups elevated; return possible Week 8+.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass game limited; Henry/Likely usage shifts.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for MNF; Eagles WR room thinned, Lemon/others elevated.
items.why: ETR OUT list; no practice midweek; confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Boost to remaining Eagles pass-catchers and opposing slot.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes to Goedert/stowers; Cowboys slot (Lemon) busy.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/active Week 7 return; Berry discusses ROS fantasy value expectations.
items.why: ETR IN list; returned and featured.
items.implication: Packers RB1 role back; ROS value solid if volume holds.

items.text: Tee Higgins: put some respect on his name (strong production call).
items.why: Berry Love/respect call on Higgins value.
items.implication: WR2/3 start with confidence alongside Chase.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner (last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) but RB13 PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-lead 45 RB targets.
items.why: Levitan data: volume/HVT outweighs efficiency; backup better YPC same scheme.
items.implication: Sustainable floor via targets/goal-line despite poor rushing metrics.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 + targets drive fantasy; role locked.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible in fantasy.
items.implication: Trade value peak post-explosion; underlying may not sustain.
items.opportunity: Volume present but sell into peak perception.

items.text: Texans WR routes (29 Stroud drops): Nico Collins 24 lead; Tank Dell only 6 on return (1st since 2024); Noel 15 left early turf toe.
items.why: Levitan post-game routes: Collins dominant share; Dell limited return role.
items.implication: Nico clear alpha; Dell handcuff/stash if expands.
items.opportunity: Collins target monopoly; Dell ramp potential.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in 2nd game w/o Rice; never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games — ceiling note.
items.why: Levitan routes data + historical ceiling limit without Rice.
items.implication: Volume up but limited upside; monitor if Rice returns.
items.opportunity: Route share expansion w/o Rice; still capped production.
items.conflict: High routes vs career yd max.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring, also slide attempt) actually hurt but uncertain severity; watching list.
items.why: Levitan: thinks actually injured unlike Gibbs, uncertain extent.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential limited role or miss.
items.opportunity: If out, Tracy or backups elevated (both ham noted).
